title: CADET: Construction of PCB Routing Instances with Executable Demonstrations
abstract: arXiv:2611.16913v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Printed circuit board (PCB) routing is the stage of physical layout that finds paths connecting the placed pads of each net. Public datasets in this domain are few, and most contain only the final states of routed boards, not demonstrations of the electronic design automation (EDA) engine actions that produce them. To close this gap, we propose CADET (Constructing executAble Demonstrations for Engine-grounded Training), which jointly generates synthetic boards and demonstrations built from EDA engine actions. The resulting RouteDemos provides 100,000 synthetic boards routed with zero design rule violations (DRVs), together with their demonstrations. Their distributions over 17 statistics resemble those of 142 real reference boards. CADET trains a routing policy on these demonstrations with behavior cloning and fine-tunes it with reinforcement learning (RL). translated_title: CADET：构建具有可执行演示的PCB布线实例
translated_abstract: 印刷电路板（PCB）布线是物理布局设计中的环节，其任务是为每个网络的已放置焊盘寻找连接路径。该领域的公开数据集很少，且大多数只包含已布线电路板的最终状态，而非产生这些结果的电子设计自动化（EDA）引擎操作的演示。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了CADET（Constructing executAble Demonstrations for Engine-grounded Training，构建基于引擎训练的可执行演示），它能够联合生成合成电路板以及由EDA引擎操作构建的演示。由此产生的RouteDemos数据集包含100,000块合成电路板，这些电路板的布线实现了零设计规则违例（DRV），并附带相应的演示数据。它们在17项统计指标上的分布与142块真实参考电路板的分布相似。CADET通过行为克隆在这些演示数据上训练布线策略，并使用强化学习（RL）对其进行微调。在真实测试电路板上，该策略将完整无设计规则违例布线的成功率从（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了CADET框架，联合生成零设计规则违例的合成PCB电路板及其对应的EDA引擎操作演示，构建了包含10万块电路板的RouteDemos数据集，并通过行为克隆与强化学习训练布线策略，在真实测试板上提升了完整无违例布线的成功率。
